title: Monthly Payment Arrangement Terms — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
These terms govern monthly payment arrangements on an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account.

**1. Who may have one.** A monthly payment arrangement may be set on a coverage account whose patient balance is at least the class's smallest balance for an arrangement.

**2. Installment.** The installment is the larger of the smallest monthly installment and the balance divided by the longest arrangement term, rounded to the cent half up; the patient may choose a larger installment but never a smaller one. *Partly retired:* for the installment of a new arrangement opened with a deposit, and for the installment of an arrangement already in force that is being revised, this clause is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis; every other arrangement installment remains under it as written.

**3. Signature.** The arrangement is set only after the patient signs it: a payment-plan agreement request for this account is in status approved.

**4. Account standing.** The arrangement can only be set while the account is in status active or terminated.

**5. First due date.** The first installment falls due on the start date the patient chooses, no later than one statement cycle after the agreement is approved.

**6. Default and completion.** When the count of missed installments reaches the class's default count the arrangement becomes defaulted; when the balance reaches 0.00 it becomes completed. A defaulted arrangement is not reinstated; a new agreement is required.

## How missed installments are counted

Due dates recur monthly from the arrangement's start date, on the same day of each later month, up to the last due date on or before the handling date. A due date is missed when the patient payments posted from that due date up to the day before the next due date total less than the monthly installment. The count is the number of most recent consecutive missed due dates.

## Example (hypothetical; installment 40.00, default count 2)

| Due date | Payments posted until the day before the next due date | Missed? |
|---|---|---|
| 5 March | 40.00 | no |
| 5 April | 25.00 | yes |
| 5 May | 0.00 | yes |

On or after 5 May the two most recent due dates are consecutive misses, so the count reaches 2 and the arrangement becomes defaulted.

superseded_clauses: The installment is the larger of `payment_plan_min_monthly` and the balance divided by `payment_plan_max_months`, rounded to the cent half up; the patient may choose a larger installment but never a smaller one.
